mustTotalPT.title: mustTotalPT
mustTotalPT.description: Total number of must-have requirements listed in MUST-HAVES. Count one per line.

mustMetPT.title: mustMetPT
mustMetPT.description: How many must-haves are MET: the card shows them, with a quote or strong implication. Never more than mustTotal.

mustPartlyPT.title: mustPartlyPT
mustPartlyPT.description: How many must-haves are PARTLY shown: some evidence but not complete. mustMet plus mustPartly must not be more than mustTotal.

niceTotalPT.title: niceTotalPT
niceTotalPT.description: Total number of nice-to-have requirements listed in NICE-TO-HAVES. Use 0 if the list is empty.

niceMetPT.title: niceMetPT
niceMetPT.description: How many nice-to-haves are MET in the card. Never more than niceTotal.

nicePartlyPT.title: nicePartlyPT
nicePartlyPT.description: How many nice-to-haves are PARTLY shown. niceMet plus nicePartly must not be more than niceTotal.

conflictCountPT.title: conflictCountPT
conflictCountPT.description: Number of items listed under “Conflicting details” in the candidate card. Use 0 if it says None.

strengthsPT.title: strengthsPT
strengthsPT.description: Two to four short sentences on the candidate’s strongest points for this role, citing short quotes from the card.

gapsPT.title: gapsPT
gapsPT.description: Requirements that are not shown or only partly shown, plus conflicts or missing data in the card, and what to ask in the interview.

detailPT.title: detailPT
detailPT.description: One line per requirement: [MUST or NICE] requirement, then MET, PARTLY or NOT SHOWN, then a short quote (no quote for NOT SHOWN).
